name: spine-values-and-tier4
body: Domain `value` nodes (deck-config, slide-position, body, link-target, field, field-type, format, body-rule, validation-error) cannot carry realised-by edges (schema: group|entity|service only). They are realised through their containing group/entity: authoring→cli-binary, templating→template-registry, validation→deck-validator. Tier-4 implemented-by edges are deferred: greenfield repo, no code yet; plan-writer declares planned FQNs. [autonomous]
